With a degree in sports development and psychology, Simon is an LTA level 5 master performance coach and has authored best-selling coaching books and over 50 professional development courses. Today, he'll be presenting Return of Serve on Court Drills for Group Coaching, sharing his expert techniques developed from training over 10,000 coaches worldwide. Welcome Simon. Well, hi everyone. My name is Simon Wheatley and I'm Director of SW19 and we're one of the world's largest coach education and player development companies. It's an honour to be presenting once again at the Tennis Australia Virtual Coaches Conference 2025. I want to say huge thank you to Scott Rawlings and the team in coach development at Tennis Australia. It's always a compliment to be asked to speak. This year on a different topic. This year on a topic that's very close to my heart, something that I think is coaches we could do better. I've tried to write something and filmed some drills that are in my opinion really relevant to coaches working in clubs with players that can play.
